instruction: Please switch VS Code to tabbed workspace mode and open workspace1.code-workspace in tab 1 and workspace2.code-workspace in tab 2.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have a 'tabbed workspace mode'. While VS Code has tabs for files/editors, workspaces cannot be organized in tabs within a single window. Each workspace requires its own window instance. The concept of workspace tabs does not exist in VS Code's architecture.
metadata.infeasibility_reason: VS Code does not support tabbed workspace mode
